name: School of Conjuration
label: Arcane Tradition
summary: A summoner and teleporter who conjures objects from thin air and blinks out of danger.
flavor: As a conjurer, you favor spells that produce objects and creatures out of thin air. You can conjure billowing clouds of killing fog or summon creatures from elsewhere to fight on your behalf. As your mastery grows, you learn spells of transportation and can teleport yourself across vast distances.
playstyle: Strong utility rather than raw power. Minor Conjuration solves an astonishing range of problems out of combat, and Benign Transposition is free repositioning that doubles as an ally rescue.

features.name: Conjuration Savant
features.description: The gold and time you must spend to copy a conjuration spell into your spellbook is halved.

features.name: Minor Conjuration
features.description:
You can use your action to conjure up an inanimate object in your hand or on the ground in an unoccupied space you can see within 10 feet. This object can be no larger than 3 feet on a side and weigh no more than 10 pounds, and its form must be that of a nonmagical object you have seen.

The object is visibly magical and disappears after 1 hour, when you use this feature again, or if it takes any damage.

features.name: Benign Transposition
features.description:
You can use your action to teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space that you can see. Alternatively, you can choose a space within range that is occupied by a Small or Medium creature; if that creature is willing, you both teleport, swapping places.

Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest or you cast a conjuration spell of 1st level or higher.

features.name: Focused Conjuration
features.description: While you are concentrating on a conjuration spell, your concentration can't be broken as a result of taking damage.

features.name: Durable Summons
features.description: Any creature that you summon or create with a conjuration spell has 30 temporary hit points.
